rules: Map explicit user.skills entries to claimed skill claims with structured-field evidence.
Keep professional bio, experience title/description, education degree/field/description, project name/description, and credential text as evidence units.
Exclude employer names, school names, dates, GPA, spoken languages, country, and other demographic or location fields.
Keep cohort, job family, seniority, seed role, and sample group only under design_labels with excluded_from_model_input=true.
Do not create candidate profiles from ESCO rows.
Preserve concept URIs as canonical identifiers.
Use preferred and alternative labels for exact candidate-claim mapping without merging source concepts.
Do not create candidate profiles from O*NET rows.
Preserve O*NET Element IDs as canonical identifiers.
Use essential-skill, knowledge, and software labels plus workplace software examples for exact candidate-claim mapping.

sources.destination: semantic extractor training and evaluation examples
rules: Do not create candidate profiles from annotated sentences.
Preserve upstream train, development, and test splits.
Convert model predictions into central claims only after independent extractor evaluation.
